name: opencode-toolkit-capability-probes
description: Not pass/fail tests - black-box capability probes against a real opencode server, answering questions about opencode's own runtime behavior (what it sends the model, which Hooks-interface keys actually fire, what common tools actually do, how permission tiers actually behave) that this repo's plugins depend on but a fake-client unit test can't observe. See tests/README.md's "Capability probes vs. tests" section.
